title: CompiledArtifact
description: A versioned compiler output holding a manifest, kernels and an execution plan (DESIGN.md § 7.1). A Cpu artifact has no kernels and no Dispatch steps (DESIGN.md § 7.1); ESS states the plan half here, not the kernels half.

artifact_hash.description: blake3 of the serialized artifact; it covers fast_math and deterministic (DESIGN.md § 3.3, § 7).

source_hash.description: Hash of the `.mspec` source compiled; the source version (DESIGN.md § 6.1).

ir_hash.description: Part of every kernel cache key (DESIGN.md § 5.3).

deterministic.description: A compile setting; no floating-point reduction is reassociated, so it is recorded in the artifact hash (DESIGN.md § 3.3, § 6.1).

schema_hash.description: Manifest; the compiler/model schema hash a checkpoint is matched against (DESIGN.md § 6.2).

parameters.description: Manifest; parameter paths, dtypes and shapes, matched against a checkpoint's (DESIGN.md § 6.2); paths are unique and no two parameters alias (DESIGN.md § 2.3).

data.description: Manifest; the input and target tensors and their shapes (DESIGN.md § 2, § 6.1).

plan.description: The execution DAG in a valid execution order (DESIGN.md § 3.1, § 7.1).

modelspec.artifact.BufferView.title: BufferView
modelspec.artifact.BufferView.description: A typed view of a plan buffer (DESIGN.md § 7.1). size_bytes equals element_count times dtype.size_bytes and offset is a multiple of alignment; ESS states neither here. Device ownership (§ 7.1) is not yet typed.

buffer.description: The plan-local number of the allocation the view lies in (DESIGN.md § 3.1 resources).

offset.description: Start of the allocation range, in bytes (DESIGN.md § 7.1).

size_bytes.description: Length of the allocation range, in bytes (DESIGN.md § 7.1).

alignment.description: Alignment of the view, in bytes (DESIGN.md § 7.1).

modelspec.artifact.ContentHash.title: ContentHash
modelspec.artifact.ContentHash.description: A blake3 digest under explicit serialization and version rules (DESIGN.md § 7).

modelspec.artifact.DataRole.title: DataRole
modelspec.artifact.DataRole.description: Whether a bound tensor is a training input or a target (DESIGN.md § 2 `input`, `target`).

modelspec.artifact.DataSpec.title: DataSpec
modelspec.artifact.DataSpec.description: One input or target tensor of the train specification, with the shape a batch must have (DESIGN.md § 2, § 6.1 tensor shapes).

modelspec.artifact.ParameterSpec.title: ParameterSpec
modelspec.artifact.ParameterSpec.description: One parameter the artifact reads and updates, by its stable path (DESIGN.md § 2.3, § 6.2).

canonical_parameter_id.description: The first 8 bytes of blake3 of the canonical path, read little-endian as an unsigned 64-bit integer; with the global seed it selects the parameter's initial values (DESIGN.md § 2.3).

modelspec.artifact.PlanOp.title: PlanOp
modelspec.artifact.PlanOp.description: The command kinds of the execution DAG (DESIGN.md § 3.1).

modelspec.artifact.PlanStep.title: PlanStep
modelspec.artifact.PlanStep.description: One command of the execution DAG (DESIGN.md § 3.1). A Dispatch names the kernel module it runs, one of its artifact's kernels (DESIGN.md § 7.1); ESS cannot state that the module belongs to the same artifact.

kernel_module_id.description: Present exactly on a Dispatch step (DESIGN.md § 7.1).

workgroups.description: Dispatch dimensions, the workgroup count per dimension; present exactly on a Dispatch step (DESIGN.md § 3.1).

reads.description: The resources the step reads, such as a Copy's source (DESIGN.md § 3.1 resource dependencies).

writes.description: The resources the step writes; for an Allocate step the scratch allocation it makes (DESIGN.md § 3.1 scratch allocations).

depends_on.description: Positions in the plan of earlier steps this one waits on, the DAG's dependencies and barriers (DESIGN.md § 3.1). That each lies before this step is not stated in ESS.

x-ess-invariants: ((op == Dispatch and defined(kernel_module_id) and defined(workgroups)) or (op != Dispatch and not (defined(kernel_module_id)) and not (defined(workgroups))))

modelspec.checkpoint.DType.title: DType
modelspec.checkpoint.DType.description: A tensor element type and its size in bytes; `f32` is the only M0/M1 dtype (DESIGN.md § 2.2).

modelspec.checkpoint.ParameterPath.title: ParameterPath
modelspec.checkpoint.ParameterPath.description: A stable canonical parameter path such as `TinyMLP.fc1.weight` (DESIGN.md § 2.3).

modelspec.checkpoint.Shape.title: Shape
modelspec.checkpoint.Shape.description: A tensor shape; each dimension is a positive integer and rank 0 is a scalar (DESIGN.md § 2.2).

modelspec.device.Extent3D.title: Extent3D
modelspec.device.Extent3D.description: A size along the three workgroup dimensions x, y and z, each positive (DESIGN.md § 3.1 dispatch dimensions, § 5.1 workgroup limits).
